{{Quote|I turn to some of the most trusted, skilled and intelligent minds that the Republic has to offer. This is the team that will help me forge a peaceful end to the current dispute.|Supreme Chancellor Palpatine|<ref name="HNN" />}}
The '''Loyalist Committee''' was created within the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], shortly before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] formed the Committee as an advisory body to himself to handle the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], cleanse the Senate of corruption (especially Separatist sympathies), and promote [[Loyalist/Legends|loyalty]] to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The original membership comprised 10 [[Senator/Legends|Senators]]:

*[[Havriso Looruya]] ([[Yir Tangee/Legends|Yir Tangee]])
*[[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]] ([[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]])
*[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Naberrie Amidala]] ([[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]])
*[[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] ([[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]])
*[[Darsana/Legends|Darsana]] ([[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]])
*[[Zo Howler]] ([[Gravlex Med/Legends|Gravlex Med]])
*[[Ronet Coorr]] ([[Iseno/Legends|Iseno]])
*[[Ister Paddie/Legends|Ister Paddie]] ([[Sermeria]])
*[[Lexi Dio/Legends|Lexi Dio]] ([[Uyter/Legends|Uyter]])
*[[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] ([[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]])

==History==
[[File:OnacondaFarr-POP.png|thumb|left|200px|Onaconda Farr replaced Havriso Looruya on the committee.]]
The committee was often a target of criticism prior to the Battle of Geonosis, with claims of being a "Shadow government" and an attempt by Palpatine to prevent the passing of the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]]. The Committee itself was split between pro-military and pro-diplomacy. One member, Orn Free Taa, was a strong Militarist during the Separatist Crisis, but he approved of the attempt by Palpatine to negotiate with the Separatists. Prior to the Battle of Geonosis, Havriso Looruya was exposed as having Separatist ties by [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] ([[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector]]), who replaced him on the Committee; also, upon the assassination of Aks Moe, Moe was replaced by [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak]] ([[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]).

In the wake of the [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|Battle of Duro]], both [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] and [[Ronet Coorr]] were forced to step down in disgrace, and [[Lexi Dio/Legends|Lexi Dio]] was assassinated and replaced on the Committee by [[Malé-Dee/Legends|Malé-Dee]] ([[Uyter/Legends|Uyter]]).

The membership of the Committee changed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and towards the end of the war included such Senators as [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] ([[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]), [[Fang Zar/Legends|Fang Zar]] ([[Sern Prime/Legends|Sern Prime]]), [[Bana Breemu/Legends|Bana Breemu]] ([[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]]), [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway Papanoida]] ([[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]]), and [[Terr Taneel/Legends|Terr Taneel]] ([[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]).<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

Interestingly, most members of the Loyalist Committee were vocal opponents of Palpatine's reformations, suggesting the Committee may really have been a means for Palpatine to keep an eye on potential enemies. The Committee found itself increasingly at odds with the Chancellor's increasing executive powers, and often had trouble gaining an audience with him. Many of the Committee members were amongst the [[Delegation of 2000]], with Amidala as their spokesman, seeking to persuade the Chancellor to surrender his emergency powers and return power to the Senate: the Delegation especially opposed the creation of the office of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]], which effectively stripped the Senate of real power.

When the Clone Wars ended and the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] was declared, at least two of the Loyalist Committee members, Organa and Mothma, went on to become leaders of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
